ruleDefinitions.name: Credential Dumping Attempt Via WerFault
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects process LSASS memory dump using Mimikatz, NanoDump, Invoke-Mimikatz, Procdump or Taskmgr based on the CallTrace pointing to ntdll.dll, dbghelp.dll or dbgcore.dll for win10, server2016 and up. Note: Unmapped fields: SourceImage, TargetImage, GrantedAccess

sequences.query: (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\lsass\\\.exe$") AND GrantedAccess = "0x1FFFFF")
